info.name: Noyo Carrier Carrier Mapped Field Member Snapshot Test Report API
Retrieves a list of Member Snapshot Test Reports.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The max size of each page of results

params.name: offset
params.description: The integer offset at which to start the page. Possible values are 0 to total_records - 1

params.name: group_id
params.description: Noyo group UUID to filter Member Snapshot Test Report

params.name: carrier_id
params.description: Noyo carrier UUID to filter Member Snapshot Test Report

items.docs: Returns a list of Member Snapshot Test Reports.

info.name: Get a single Member Snapshot Test Report

params.name: member_snapshot_test_report_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the Member Snapshot Test Report you would like to view

items.docs: Returns the latest version of a single Member Snapshot Test Report based on the ID provided.
